recruit.brief: Now a flat straight, 150 m long. Before you drive, guess which gear will reach the highest top speed. Then test every gear and find out.
recruit.question: Which gear will reach the highest top speed?

cadet.brief: Now a long flat road. Which gear goes fastest? Guess, then try them all.
cadet.question: Which gear will go the fastest?

operative.brief: A 150 m flat straight. Predict which gear ratio gives the highest top speed, then test every ratio.
operative.question: Which gear ratio reaches the highest top speed?
